evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports a strong MATH Level 5 score of 33.99% for this model.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports a MATH Level 5 score of 33.99%, which is low enough to indicate the model will frequently produce factually incorrect outputs on mathematical reasoning tasks.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,336 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit, combined with the SLERP merge method. The merged models are FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-o1-8B and Skywork/Skywork-o1-Open-Llama-3.1-8B.
training_context.training_data: This checkpoint is a merge of two pre-trained language models, FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-o1-8B and Skywork/Skywork-o1-Open-Llama-3.1-8B, created using mergekit.
